description: Execute stateful pre-flight simulation across EVM (eth_simulateV1 with stateOverrides, multi-tx bundles, and Transfer/Approval net asset diffs; fallback eth_call + eth_estimateGas) and Solana (simulateTransaction + wire instruction audit) BEFORE signing (100 free calls/day/IP).

to.description: Destination 0x smart contract address (required for single EVM call)

transaction.description: Base64/Base58 serialized Solana transaction when chain='solana'

transactions.description: Optional ordered multi-tx EVM bundle [{ to, data, value }]

value.description: Native wei amount as hex ('0x0') or decimal string

name: nullclear_simulate_transaction
